correctness.rationale: In each collision-free ordered chamber the exponential has kinetic eigenvalue −sum a_j² and satisfies the Robin normal derivative −a_1=−κ. Across each contact x_j=x_(j+1), (∂_(j+1)−∂_j)Ψ=(a_j−a_(j+1))Ψ=gΨ, matching the 2g δ normalization. In gap coordinates y_k=x_(k)−x_(k−1), the coefficients A_k=(N−k+1)(κ−g(N+k−2)/2) are all positive exactly when κ>(N−1)g; integrating exp(−2sum A_k y_k) gives C_N²=∏2A_k/N!. The final gap has Exponential(2A_N), hence mean 1/(2a_N), and E_(N−1)−E_N=a_N². A positive normalized eigenfunction of the positivity-improving boson Schrödinger operator is the ground state, not a claim of complete excited spectrum. Independent exact symbolic/rational checks verified contact and gap identities in three parameter examples; infinite N proof is analytical.
